items.description: Return authorized workspace path rules, path area descriptors (vault, shared, local), available mounts, and the workspace file tool catalog.
items.name: workspace_root

items.description: List folders and files. Hermes equivalent: list/search file names. Paths: Vault's own files have no prefix (e.g. Idea Lab/README.md, never vault/...); folders shared by others are under shared/{owner}/{mount}/...; folders on the user's computer are under local/{mount}/.... Paths are relative, with single slashes. Call workspace_root or list shared/ and local/ for the current mounts; do not assume folder names.
items.name: workspace_list_directory

items.description: Read one text file. For long files read part of it with startLine/endLine (1-based, inclusive), or the first/last lines with head/tail; totalLines tells you how long it is. Hermes equivalent: read_file. Paths: Vault's own files have no prefix (e.g. Idea Lab/README.md, never vault/...); folders shared by others are under shared/{owner}/{mount}/...; folders on the user's computer are under local/{mount}/.... Paths are relative, with single slashes. Call workspace_root or list shared/ and local/ for the current mounts; do not assume folder names.
items.name: workspace_read_file

items.description: Search file and folder names, then the text of small text files, under a directory prefix. Large areas stop early with truncated=true; then search a more specific directory. Hermes equivalent: search_files(target=content). Paths: Vault's own files have no prefix (e.g. Idea Lab/README.md, never vault/...); folders shared by others are under shared/{owner}/{mount}/...; folders on the user's computer are under local/{mount}/.... Paths are relative, with single slashes. Call workspace_root or list shared/ and local/ for the current mounts; do not assume folder names.
items.name: workspace_search_files

items.description: Create a new text workspace file. Hermes equivalent: write_file for new files. Paths: Vault's own files have no prefix (e.g. Idea Lab/README.md, never vault/...); folders shared by others are under shared/{owner}/{mount}/...; folders on the user's computer are under local/{mount}/.... Paths are relative, with single slashes. Call workspace_root or list shared/ and local/ for the current mounts; do not assume folder names.
items.name: workspace_write_file

items.description: Replace the full contents of an existing text file with contentMarkdown. For a small change use workspace_patch_file instead. Hermes equivalent: write_file for full replacement edits. Paths: Vault's own files have no prefix (e.g. Idea Lab/README.md, never vault/...); folders shared by others are under shared/{owner}/{mount}/...; folders on the user's computer are under local/{mount}/.... Paths are relative, with single slashes. Call workspace_root or list shared/ and local/ for the current mounts; do not assume folder names.
items.name: workspace_save_file

items.description: Change part of one existing text file: oldString is the exact text to find (it must appear once unless replaceAll=true) and newString replaces it. Read the file first. Prefer this to rewriting the whole file. Hermes equivalent: patch(mode=replace). Paths: Vault's own files have no prefix (e.g. Idea Lab/README.md, never vault/...); folders shared by others are under shared/{owner}/{mount}/...; folders on the user's computer are under local/{mount}/.... Paths are relative, with single slashes. Call workspace_root or list shared/ and local/ for the current mounts; do not assume folder names.
items.name: workspace_patch_file

items.description: Create a workspace folder. items.name: workspace_create_directory
